children: said on Thursday its unit had signed an exclusive development and licensing agreement with a subsidiary of GSK
to develop and commercialise its investigational cancer drug, HMPL-A830.
The agreement grants the British drug maker's unit worldwide rights to develop and commercialise the drug outside Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan.
